name: backlog
description: Two-way sync between haren tasks and a Backlog.md board
setup: sh -c 'if [ -f backlog/config.yml ] || [ -f backlog/config.yaml ] || [ -f .backlog/config.yml ] || [ -f .backlog/config.yaml ] || [ -f backlog.config.yml ] || [ -f backlog.json ] || [ -f "$1/backlog/config.yml" ] || [ -f "$1/backlog/config.yaml" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ "$2" = workspace ]; then if git -C "$1" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$1" && backlog init "$0" --defaults --backlog-dir backlog --config-location folder --agent-instructions none; else cd "$1" && backlog init "$0" --defaults --backlog-dir backlog --config-location folder --agent-instructions none --no-git; fi; exit; fi; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then backlog init "$0" --defaults --backlog-dir "$1/backlog" --config-location root --agent-instructions none; else backlog init "$0" --defaults --backlog-dir "$1/backlog" --config-location root --agent-instructions none --no-git; fi' '{{project}}' '{{harenDir}}' '{{layout}}'
